title: You can get better quality for less money with other brands.
text: You can get better quality for less money with other brands.. I rarely write reviews but thought I should for this product.  Firstly, it does work and it does keep your drink hot or cold.  However, I believe it's greatly overpriced.  For the money you should just get a Yeti or an Rtic brand tumbler.  This brand has a flimsy feel to it.  I'm not sure but the gauge of steel used seems thinner than either the Yeti or Rtic.  Also, the lid is thinner and the o-ring is too small allowing the lid to come off easier.  In addition, the slider on the lid to close the drinking hole is cheaply designed and doesn't hold it's position open or closed very well.  For about half the price you can get an Rtic brand who's quality is on par with Yeti.  No, I don't have any stake in Rtic or Yeti.  I own both brands though and this is my honest opinion.
